guard: a human chat post carries the @names in its text, a reply to a channel message is answered on its channel with replyTo, and a grant refusal names the reopen step
why: The workspace smokes import `../src`, so their mutations need no build. `chat-pure` and
`chat-static:live` reach the chat rules through `@cotal-ai/workspace/chat`, which resolves to
`dist/`, so those commands build workspace first and every one of them rebuilds on restore.

mutations.name: publish sends no mentions on a channel post
mutations.expectRed: a channel post carries the @names its text holds as mentions
mutations.cell: a channel post carries the @names its text holds as mentions

mutations.name: publish drops a channel reply's replyTo
mutations.expectRed: a channel reply carries its replyTo to the session
mutations.cell: a channel reply carries its replyTo to the session

mutations.name: publish drops a peer reply's replyTo
mutations.find: return session.dm({ principal: to.principal }, text, to.replyTo);
mutations.expectRed: a peer reply goes by principal with its replyTo
mutations.cell: a peer reply goes by principal with its replyTo

mutations.name: replyRecipient DMs a channel message's sender
mutations.expectRed: a reply to a channel message is answered on its channel, quoting its id
mutations.cell: a reply to a channel message is answered on its channel, quoting its id

mutations.name: replyRecipient stops refusing your own DM or role task
mutations.find: if (m.from.id === self) return { refused: "that is your own message" };
mutations.expectRed: a reply to your own DM or role task refuses
mutations.cell: a reply to your own DM or role task refuses

mutations.name: a channel reply loses its reply mark
mutations.expectRed: a channel reply reads as a reply
mutations.cell: a channel reply reads as a reply

mutations.name: settlePublish keeps a stored channel reply's replyTo
mutations.expectRed: a stored channel reply drops its replyTo and stays on the channel
mutations.cell: a stored channel reply drops its replyTo and stays on the channel

mutations.name: send drops replyTo
mutations.expectRed: send with mentions and replyTo reaches the agent with both
mutations.cell: send with mentions and replyTo reaches the agent with both

mutations.name: publish sends no mentions, on a real broker
mutations.expectRed: the reply lands on #general with the @names in its text and the question's id
mutations.cell: the reply lands on #general with the @names in its text and the question's id

mutations.name: replyRecipient DMs a channel message's sender, on a real broker
mutations.expectRed: the agent's channel message is answered on its channel
mutations.cell: the agent's channel message is answered on its channel

mutations.name: a post outside a non-empty grant drops the reopen step
mutations.expectRed: a post outside a non-empty grant names the reopen step too
mutations.cell: a post outside a non-empty grant names the reopen step too

mutations.name: cotal chat --plain sends no mentions
mutations.expectRed: a --plain line `hi @peer` reaches a --stdio session named peer as a message that mentions it
mutations.cell: a --plain line `hi @peer` reaches a --stdio session named peer as a message that mentions it
